US.description: Covers typical expenses such as groceries, transportation, utilities, healthcare, and leisure activities across various US urban and suburban areas.

IN.description: Cost of living for essentials like groceries, local transportation, utilities, and mid-range dining. Generally affordable compared to Western countries, but can vary based on lifestyle choices and city.

SG.description: Generally high, driven by imported goods, dining out, and car ownership costs. Public transport is efficient and relatively affordable.

CH.description: Cost of living is extremely high across all categories including groceries, transportation, and dining out.

NL.description: Covers expenses for groceries, public transportation, utilities, and general leisure activities for a single person.

GB.description: Cost of living, excluding rent, is moderately high for a single person, covering expenses such as groceries, utilities, transport, and leisure activities across UK cities.

CA.description: High costs for groceries, transportation, and utilities, with slightly higher prices in major urban centers.

AE.description: The cost of living excluding rent in the UAE, especially in major cities like Dubai and Abu Dhabi, is high due to expenses like groceries, dining, and transportation.

NO.description: High cost of groceries, transportation, and leisure activities. Healthcare and education are subsidized.

IE.description: High cost of groceries, utilities, and transportation, particularly in major cities like Dublin.

LU.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, transportation, and services, reflecting overall wealth and high wages.

AU.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and personal care in major Australian cities.

QA.description: Cost of living is moderate, with groceries being reasonable but utilities and some services relatively high. Public transport is developing but private car ownership is common.

BN.description: The cost of living excluding rent in Brunei Darussalam is moderate. Local food, public transportation, and utilities are generally affordable. However, imported goods, electronics, and certain leisure activities can be relatively expensive compared to other Southeast Asian countries.

MO.description: High cost of living driven by imported goods and dining out, with more moderate prices for local services and transportation.
